title: ColorScheme DTCG
description: W3C DTCG-format palette-axis file (colorscheme.<id>.json). Stored as colorscheme.json inside the .apextheme zip. Parsed by ColorScheme::from_dtcg in src-tauri/src/design_system/loader.rs. Every palette entry is a DTCG token: { "$type": "color", "$value": "#rrggbb" }. Missing entries fall back to builtin_dark() equivalents so partial/override files work without specifying every color.

Meta.title: Meta
Meta.description: Identity and dark/light flag — parsed directly (not as DTCG tokens).

name.description: Human-readable display name. Falls back to id when absent.

is_dark.description: true for dark palettes, false for light ones. Defaults to true when absent.

ColorToken.title: ColorToken
ColorToken.description: A DTCG color token. $value must be #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa hex string.

$value.description: Hex color string. #rrggbb for fully opaque, #rrggbbaa for explicit alpha.

Palette.title: Palette
Palette.description: All palette fields. Required fields must be present; optional fields (extended semantic palette + pane_gap_color) are omitted when None. Field defaults come from builtin_dark().

surface.description: Elevated surface — panels, cards, toolbars. Default: #1c1c1cff.

dim.description: Muted / secondary text, disabled labels, placeholders. Default: #787878ff.

accent.description: Brand / interactive accent — buttons, focus rings, links. Default: #6366f1ff.

bull.description: Upward / positive price movement. Also the fallback for resolved_success() when success is None. Default: #34d399ff.

bear.description: Downward / negative price movement. Also the fallback for resolved_danger() when danger is None. Default: #f87171ff.

warn.description: Warning / caution state. Also the fallback for resolved_warning() when warning is None. Default: #fbbf24ff.

shadow.description: Shadow tint color (used by elevation helpers). Typically near-black for dark themes, near-neutral for light. Default: #000000b4.

gold.description: Gold accent — warm yellow used for highlights. Default: #ffc125ff.

overlay_text.description: Overlay / HUD foreground text color. Default: #f0f0f0ff.

rrg_leading.description: RRG leading quadrant color (strong bull). Default: #34d399ff.

rrg_improving.description: RRG improving quadrant color (trending up). Default: #6366f1ff.

rrg_weakening.description: RRG weakening quadrant color (warning, trending down). Default: #fbbf24ff.

rrg_lagging.description: RRG lagging quadrant color (strong bear). Default: #f87171ff.

pinned_row_tint.description: Subtle tint behind pinned rows (premultiplied alpha). Default: #0000000c.

text_muted.description: Muted text variant — secondary body copy. Default: #aaaab4ff.

hud_bg.description: HUD / floating overlay background (premultiplied alpha). Default: #000000e6.

hud_border.description: HUD / floating overlay border color. Default: #32323cff.

success.description: EXTENDED SEMANTIC (S1): General success / positive state — not price-specific. When absent, resolved_success() falls back to bull. Set independently for richer UI states (e.g. a muted green vs. a vivid bull color).

danger.description: EXTENDED SEMANTIC (S1): General danger / error / destructive action state. When absent, resolved_danger() falls back to bear.

warning.description: EXTENDED SEMANTIC (S1): General warning / caution state (semantic alias over warn). When absent, resolved_warning() falls back to warn.

info.description: EXTENDED SEMANTIC (S1): Informational / neutral highlight — help text, info badges, links. No direct legacy equivalent. When absent, resolved_info() defaults to a muted blue (#64a0dcff for dark, #1e64b4ff for light).

pane_gap_color.description: Override color for the gutter between adjacent panes. When absent, renderers derive the gap color from bg/border at paint time. Most themes leave this absent.

cmd_palette.description: 11-color command-palette category badge palette. Each element is a DTCG color token ($type: "color", $value: "#rrggbbaa"). Slot order: [symbol, widget, overlay, theme, timeframe, layout, play, alert, ai, dynamic, calc]. When absent or partially present, missing slots fall back to CMD_PALETTE_DEFAULT. Themes that want custom badge colors can set all 11 slots here.
